name: PWA-AI-Preschool
description: AI Preschool Studio: fictional-data PWA demo - class portfolios with ratings, comments, photos, AI-assisted narratives and Simplified Chinese PDF reports

paragraphs: A neutral, fictional-data static PWA for class portfolios: 20 sample children, semester comparison, four-domain narrative drafting, local review and printable child/class reports. The root is the only application host. class.html redirects to the root while preserving the hash route, including editor and print links.
Use fictional records only. Never enter real child, family, staff, photo, voice or workplace data. Browser storage and local review are not secure records storage or authenticated approval.

Status (2026-10-17): browser-only fictional-data prototype, not a production school system. The i18n update is local; its final integration verification will be recorded separately in the changelog by the integration owner. This documentation update did not inspect Git history or reverify the published build, live providers or Gateway. Historical QA remains revision-specific; machine-translated locale coverage is not native-speaker acceptance.
